WITH project_rates AS (
  SELECT
    s.arcref,
    p.fundflux,
    AVG(s.gbsize / s.spanmin) AS rate
  FROM scans AS s
  JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref
  WHERE s.gbsize IS NOT NULL
    AND s.spanmin IS NOT NULL
    AND s.spanmin <> 0
  GROUP BY s.arcref, p.fundflux
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_project_rate
  FROM project_rates
)
SELECT
  pr.arcref,
  pr.fundflux,
  pr.rate,
  pr.rate - b.avg_project_rate AS gap_above_benchmark
FROM project_rates AS pr
CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b
WHERE pr.rate > b.avg_project_rate
ORDER BY gap_above_benchmark DESC
LIMIT 10;
